s1_headline: "Fresh clams are better." We still reach for the can most weeks.
s2_headline: Fresh littlenecks mean a special grocery trip, same day, no substitutions.
s2_subline: Canned clams are already in the pantry on a random Tuesday. That counts for something.
s3_headline: Shucking is also just messier than most recipes let on.
s3_subline: Shells, grit, a sink full of brine — for a pizza that's on the table in 20 minutes either way.
s4_headline: Start with canned, get the build right, then upgrade to fresh.
